definitions.mu(h): E[G|h] for G=(R-b) grad log pi(full response|prompt)
definitions.S_x: sum of the vector over the group's live prefixes of problem x at position t
definitions.U_ab: mean over ordered pairs of distinct problems of <S^a_x, S^b_y>; unbiased for <E S^a, E S^b>
definitions.D_ab: mean over problems of <S^a_x, S^b_x>; same-prefix terms pair independent halves
definitions.F_pop: U_PM / U_MM: share of the population update grad J carried by the prefix-determined part
definitions.residual_pop: ||E S^mu - E S^P||^2 / ||E S^mu||^2: squared relative error of the prefix part
definitions.F_batch(m): (D_PM + (m-1) U_PM) / (D_MM + (m-1) U_MM): the same share for a batch of m problems
definitions.F_prefix: sum_h <P(h),mu(h)> / sum_h ||mu(h)||^2, the per-prefix energy share used in PR11-PR13
definitions.aggregation_survival: U_MM / D_MM: fraction of per-problem update energy surviving aggregation
definitions.rho_A: sum_h Var(R|h) / sum_x k_x Var(R|x), live prefixes only
definitions.gap: rho_A - residual_pop; positive means the update is more settled than the answer
definitions.views: pooled uses both halves; half_b selects on half A and estimates on half B only

bootstrap_unit: problem, shared across positions and groups
assumptions: binary rewards; baseline fixed per prefix; suffixes sampled from the policy whose scores are stored; finished prefixes are not replayed
